title: Mahiro pack
description: Simple Mahiro pack for fans (in development) + Tomoko background
body:
#
🎀Mahiro pack🎀
> Member of BBA presents you a themed resource pack **Mahiro pack**. Adds a lot of **references to the anime** **[Onimai:I'm Now Your Sister!](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Onimai)** **new item textures, animated HUD/UI, background, sound effects** (in development). If you are a fan try to use it **>.<** #
⚠️Warning⚠️
> This resource pack **may include** references from **other anime/manga** (around 1-5%), but the main theme would be **Onimai** > If you want **ONIMAI** to be the **MAIN THEME**, make sure you download the **standard version** of this pack instead of **multiverse version** (For example: **1.2** - **standard** version, while **1.2mv** is **multiverse version**) ‎
